items.finding: Persistent multi-mission governance contracts require executable ownership, handoff, stale-state, bootstrap-replay, attribution and recovery enforcement.
items.required_action: Implement control-plane enforcement without duplicating the scientific architecture.
items.proposed_action: Use dependency-free control-plane primitives and adversarial tests; reconcile branch-local state with main-branch governance evidence.
constraints: Do not silently overwrite conflicting state

items.finding: Protected-core perimeter, identity mapping, branch protection and cryptographic root-of-trust are not fully verified; technical security enforcement gaps remain.
items.required_action: Reconcile security authority and implement only technically authorized controls after required human decisions.
items.proposed_action: Persist security blockers and enforce fail-closed boundaries; do not infer human authority or protected-core scope.
constraints: Human decisions required for canonical protected-core and identity mapping

integration_rule: A handoff is not INTEGRATED unless it has reached VERIFIED and has an integrated_at timestamp. A created or accepted handoff never changes the destination mission state by assertion alone.
